articles.headline: Jay-Z's greatest sports lyrics, ranked ahead of his Super Bowl show
articles.description: The Super Bowl headliner's catalog is packed with sports references -- here are the ones that top our list.

images.name: Jay-Z's best athlete references, ranked ahead of SoFi shows [1296x729]
images.caption: Jay-Z's catalog is packed with sports references -- here are the ones that top our list.
images.alt: Mike Tyson, LeBron James, Jay-z, Dwyane Wade, Shaquille O'Neal, Kobe Bryant & Michael Jordan

images.name: Jay Z MJ [608x342]
images.caption: Jordan is a recurring reference in Jay-Z’s lyrics, with the rapper frequently name-dropping the basketball legend throughout his career.
images.alt: (L-R) Michael Jordan, Chris Paul, and Jay-Z attend the 2010 World Basketball Festival Tip Off after party

images.name: Shaq lifting Kobe [608x342]
images.caption: O’Neal memorably hoisted Bryant in the air as the Lakers celebrated their title-clinching Game 6 win over the Pacers in the 2000 NBA Finals.
images.alt: Kobe Bryant #8 and Shaquille O'Neal #34 of the Los Angeles Lakers celebrate winning in Game Six of the 2000 NBA Finals against the Indiana Pacers on  June 19, 2000 a

images.name: Jay Z Kobe [608x342]
images.caption: Jay-Z and Beyoncé were familiar faces courtside throughout Bryant’s 20-year  career, including his 60-point farewell in April 2016.
images.alt: Jay-Z (L) and Kobe Bryant (R) greet each other at the Los Angeles Lakers vs Houston Rockets game at Staples Center

images.name: jay-z yankees
images.caption: Jay-Z has long repped his hometown New York Yankees, making their fitted cap a wardrobe staple. Here, he attends Game 5 of the 2011 ALDS against the Detroit Tigers.

images.name: Penny Hardaway
images.caption: Lil Penny debuted in late 1995 to promote the Nike Air Penny 1, pairing Hardaway's quiet persona with a puppet full of personality.

images.name: Randall Cunningham
images.caption: Randall Cunningham earned first-team All-Pro honors and led the Minnesota Vikings to a 15-1 record in 1998.

images.name: LeBron/Stevenson
images.caption: After the Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Washington Wizards in March 2008, DeShawn Stevenson publicly dismissed LeBron James as "overrated." James answered by drawing a musical comparison: Stevenson was Soulja Boy, and he was Jay-Z.

images.name: Mike Tyson Peter McNeely [608x342]
images.caption: Three years in prison gave way to just 89 seconds in the ring when Mike Tyson faced Peter McNeeley at the MGM Grand on August 19, 1995.
images.alt: First Mike Tyson fight since his release faces Peter Mac Neeley at MGM Grand.

images.name: Jeff Gordon Jay Z [608x342]
images.caption: The two have met in person -- including this appearance together at the amfAR New York Gala in 2016.
images.alt: Retired race car driver Jeff Gordon and rapper Jay Z attend the amFAR New York Gala at Cipriani Wall Street in New York, NY on February 10, 2016.

images.name: ESPY Trophies
images.caption: Jay-Z is the second-most awarded rapper in Grammy history behind Kendrick Lamar, with 25 wins -- but he has yet to take home an ESPY despite name-dropping the award show in this bar.
